_comment: Pre-declared before running: an independent repeat of V1/V2 for parent_sampler=envelope, after the first envelope run failed V2. Committed before the jobs start; the result is judged only by the rule below.

previous_result.V2: fail: min p 5.6e-5 < 1e-4 (he_pi0_cuboid_m045 parent_theta); KS 0.12; max tail pull 2.31
previous_result.follow_up: compare_parent_samplers.py, 1.34e8 parents per sampler on an A100: no difference in p, theta, pT or v (p 0.14-0.88)

rerun.trials: as validation/run_v_set.sh (5e8 per mb_pi0 point, 4e7 per he_pi0 point)
rerun.reference: the same stock reference sets as every earlier run

control.role: reported alongside; a failure here would point at the criteria or the reference, not at the envelope, and is reported as such

envelope_validated_if_all: the rerun passes every V1 and V2 criterion of v_config.json
the histogram that failed before, he_pi0_cuboid_m045 parent_theta, has p > 0.01 in the rerun
no envelope bound violation (parent_over_bar = 0) in any shard
decision_rule.otherwise: not validated; next step is a targeted look at the parents of detected DM (theta, p) in the envelope against the stock sampler at high statistics
decision_rule.no_further_reruns: a third run to obtain a pass is not allowed under this rule; it would need a new declaration with reasons
decision_rule.reporting: both envelope runs (failed and rerun) and the control are reported in docs/gpu-validation.md whatever the outcome
